name: Global Affairs Canada
access: Open calls, unsolicited proposals, invitations and country-level mechanisms
why: WaterAid Canada has an established funding relationship with GAC, including SWISH, SHARE, IGNIT3 and EmpowerHer.

name: Roncalli International Foundation
geography: ~50 countries in Africa, Asia, Caribbean, Latin America
access: Online Admission platform; new partners need reference
why: Explicit Water and Sanitation action area and strong overlap with WaterAid countries.

name: Peter Gilgan Foundation
why: Recent grants show direct WASH and maternal/child-health giving in Nigeria and Ethiopia.

name: Grand Challenges Canada
status: Current and periodic global health calls
access: Open calls only; no unsolicited proposals
why: Canadian global-health funder with large international footprint; WASH fit depends on the specific health innovation call.

name: International Development Research Centre (IDRC)
status: Research funding calls and institutional grants
access: Mostly solicited calls; rare unsolicited ideas
why: Strong for research/evidence partnerships where WASH intersects climate, health or systems change.

name: Mastercard Foundation
why: Not a core WASH funder, but strategic overlap exists in several WaterAid countries through youth, women, livelihoods and health systems.

name: Aqueduct Foundation
geography: Grants to Canadian registered charities; some international/non-qualified-donee grantmaking through approved processes
access: Relationship / donor-advised-fund recommendations; not an open application program
why: WaterAid Canada listed Aqueduct Foundation among transformational foundation supporters in 2020/21. Aqueduct makes thousands of donor-advised grants and can grant to Canadian registered charities.

name: Benefaction Foundation
status: Active; donor-advised granting, no general unsolicited applications
geography: Canadian registered charities and qualified donees
why: WaterAid Canada listed Benefaction Foundation among transformational foundation supporters in 2020/21. Benefaction grants to Canadian registered charities based primarily on donor recommendations.

name: Donner Canadian Foundation
geography: Canada plus selected international development and human-rights grants
access: Invitation-only; cultivate relationship rather than submit unsolicited proposal
why: WaterAid Canada listed Donner Canadian Foundation as a transformational supporter in 2020/21. Donner remains invitation-only and its current portfolio includes some international-development grants.

name: One Drop Foundation
status: Active international WASH programming; does not accept project proposals
geography: International WASH projects including WaterAid countries such as Colombia, India, Madagascar, Malawi, Mali and Burkina Faso
access: Partnership cultivation / co-design; One Drop says it does not accept project proposals
why: One Drop has partnered directly with WaterAid Canada on Mali: Healthy Communities and runs international WASH projects in multiple WaterAid countries.
